scenario: AFTER fix — one GROUP BY query replaces the per-row COUNT loop
seedData: 300 quotes across 6 authors (same database as the before trace)

spans.dbStatement:
SELECT "q"."Author", COUNT(*) AS "Count"
FROM "Quotes" AS "q"
GROUP BY "q"."Author"

diagnosis: Same 300-quote database as the before trace. The endpoint now issues exactly 2 database queries total regardless of row count: one to list the quotes, one GROUP BY query that computes every author's count in a single round trip. 301 child spans collapsed to 2, and root span duration dropped from ~26ms to ~3.8ms in steady state (after JIT warm-up).
